summary: Completed targeted backend+frontend regression for public manuals, reconciliation print matched-balance placement, LAN/local installer scripts, setup download binary integrity, and auth playbook checks.

critical.issue: Public preflight still returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* and omits Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true, breaking credentialed CORS expectation.
Lockout is triggered before 5 failed attempts (received 429 on 4th/5th), while playbook/test_credentials require lockout after 5.

action_items: Fix edge/ingress CORS policy precedence so credentialed auth preflight returns explicit origin + Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true.
Align lockout implementation with documented policy (5 failed attempts) or update all playbook/docs/UI wording consistently.
Retest auth preflight and brute-force lockout scenarios on public URL after deployment changes.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py still hardcodes LOGIN_LOCKOUT_FAILED_ATTEMPTS = 3, conflicting with current test credential notes requiring 5 attempts.
backend/server.py remains very large (single-file architecture), increasing change risk and regression surface.
